Cookie Policy

SafePsy (OÜ) uses only essential cookies by default. Analytics and functional cookies require your explicit consent. You may withdraw consent at any time. This policy complies with the GDPR and the ePrivacy Directive.

Last updated: August 2026

What Are Cookies?

Cookies are small text files stored on your device. SafePsy uses cookies only with your consent (except where strictly necessary for the service to function). We do not sell or share any cookie data with third parties for advertising purposes.

Small Files

Tiny text files stored on your device to remember your preferences

User Experience

Help personalize your experience and remember your settings

Privacy Safe

Used responsibly with your privacy and security in mind

Detailed Cookie Inventory

Every cookie set by SafePsy, classified by purpose, legal basis, and consent requirement under the GDPR and ePrivacy Directive.

Essential Cookies

No consent required

These cookies are strictly necessary for the website to function. They enable core features such as authentication, security, and load balancing. Without these cookies, the service cannot be provided. Legal basis: GDPR Art. 6(1)(f) (legitimate interest).

Cookie NameProviderPurposeDurationLegal BasisConsent Required

Analytics Cookies

Consent required

These cookies help us understand how visitors interact with our website. All analytics data is self-hosted (no Google servers). We collect anonymous session timing, conversion funnel milestones, and device types — never health data, messages, or wallet addresses in raw form. Legal basis: GDPR Art. 6(1)(a) (consent).

Cookie NameProviderPurposeDurationLegal BasisConsent Required
sp_product_metricsFirst-partyConversion funnel timestamps (landing, wallet connect, DID, first message) — no PII24 monthsArt. 6(1)(a) — ConsentYes
analytics_cookiesFirst-partyRecords whether analytics consent was granted24 monthsArt. 6(1)(c) — Legal obligationYes*
safepsy_vidFirst-partyAnonymous visitor ID (UUID) for counting unique visitors without identifying them12 monthsArt. 6(1)(a) — ConsentYes
safepsy_sidFirst-partyAnonymous session ID for counting sessions without identifying users30 minutes inactivityArt. 6(1)(a) — ConsentYes

How We Protect Your Data

Data Protection Measures

Self-Hosted Analytics

Our primary analytics SDK runs on our own infrastructure. No data passes through Google servers unless you explicitly enable GA4.

No Raw PII in Cookies

Analytics cookies store anonymous UUIDs, timestamps, and coarse device info. No wallet addresses, health data, or messages.

Consent-First Loading

No analytics scripts or tracking pixels load until you give explicit consent. Essential cookies only run by default.

Your Rights Under the GDPR

Right to Withdraw Consent

Click "Cookie Preferences" in the footer or use the consent panel in the banner. Withdrawal takes effect immediately.

Right to Access

Request a copy of any analytics data we hold about you via our contact form.

Right to Erasure

Delete your entire account (including all analytics data) via Account Settings, or contact us directly.

Managing Your Preferences

You have full control over your cookie preferences. You can change your choices at any time.

Cookie Consent Manager

SafePsy's consent manager allows you to:

  • Accept or reject analytics, functional, and marketing cookies independently
  • Withdraw consent previously given — this takes immediate effect
  • View detailed descriptions of every cookie and its purpose
  • Save preferences, which are recorded on our backend for audit purposes

Open the consent manager from the banner or footer:

Browser Settings

Chrome

Settings → Privacy and security → Cookies and other site data

Firefox

Options → Privacy & Security → Cookies and Site Data

Safari

Preferences → Privacy → Manage Website Data

Edge

Settings → Cookies and site permissions → Cookies and site data

Questions About Our Cookie Policy?

If you have any questions about how we use cookies or would like to exercise your rights, contact us.
